newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-FAI Cup first round ties.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-FAI Cup first round ties.

text.p: This weekend's Football Association of Ireland (FAI) senior challenge cup first round ties. In the event of any two sides being level at the end of 90 minutes, then 30 minutes extra-time will be played.
Friday, January 10.
Shelbourne vs Everton (Cork) at Tolka Park, 1945 GMT.
St.Patrick's Athletic vs Athlone Town at Richmond Park, 1945 GMT.
Waterford United vs Monaghan United at Waterford Regional Sports Centre, 1945 GMT.
Saturday, January 11.
University College Dublin vs Bray Wanderers at Belfield Park, 1515 GMT.
Derry City vs Crumlin United at The Brandywell, 1930 GMT.
Home Farm/Everton vs Glenmore Celtic at Whitehall, 1930 GMT.
Cobh Ramblers vs Sligo Rovers at St.Colman's Park, 1915 GMT.
Dublin University vs Parkvilla at College Grounds, Santry, at 1400 GMT.
Longford Town vs St.Francis at Strokestown Road, Longford, 1930 GMT.
Sunday, January 12.
Garda vs Drogheda United at Westmanstown, Clonsilla, County Dublin, 1400 GMT.
Cork City vs Galway United at Turners Cross, 1400 GMT.
Wayside Celtic vs Finn Harps at Carlisle Grounds, 1400 GMT.
Kilkenny City vs Bohemians at Buckley Park, 1415 GMT.
Whitehall Rangers (Dublin) vs Dundalk at Paddy Mahony Park, Dublin Airport grounds, 1400 GMT.
Valeview Shankill vs Rockmount at Stradbrook, Blackrock, at 1400 GMT.
Shamrock Rovers vs Limerick at Tolka Park, 1515 GMT.
